_: Model aliases: one friendly name -> what each harness calls that model. Copied to ~/.agent-home/models.json on install (edit that copy). Consumed by scripts/port-agents.py to map agent `model:` fields, and readable by any agent (AGENTS.md points here) when you name a model by alias.
__gateway: Aliases whose claude-code value contains a '/' are served to Claude Code by the LiteLLM proxy — launch them with `claude-with <alias>`. `context` is the model's real input window; Claude Code otherwise assumes 200k and auto-compacts at the wrong point. Claude Code sends ~135k tokens of MCP tool definitions on every request, so anything under ~200k needs `claude-with <alias> --lite`.
